name: Rate-limited API: a token bucket sheds a burst before it reaches the workers
description: Steady 20/s traffic jumps to 80/s for one minute. The limiter allows 40/s sustained with a burst of 100, so about a quarter of all requests are rejected (limiter.RejectionFraction) and the 25 workers at 0.5 s each (capacity 50/s) throttle only about 1.6% (pool.ThrottleFraction). Raise the limiter rate to 80 to see the pool throttle heavily instead.
